patterns.name: rust_panic_stacktrace
patterns.regex: thread '.*' panicked at[\s\S]{0,500}?(?:stack backtrace:|note: run with)

patterns.name: repeated_restart_pattern
patterns.description: Container restart loop — multiple restarts in quick succession

patterns.name: oom_kill_sequence
patterns.description: OOM kill event — kernel killed a process for memory pressure

patterns.name: gpu_xid_error
patterns.description: NVIDIA Xid error event from kernel

patterns.name: solana_rpc_failure_burst
patterns.regex: (?:RPC request error|Failed to send|blockhash expired).*\n(?:.*(?:RPC request error|Failed to send|blockhash expired).*\n){2,}
patterns.description: Burst of Solana RPC failures — possible network or RPC issues

patterns.name: disk_io_error
patterns.description: Disk I/O error — possible hardware failure
